widerruf.note: Withdrawal without an account — guest orders included
widerruf.intro_dialog: You can withdraw from your contract here. No customer account is needed. We confirm receipt by email without delay.
widerruf.intro_page: Use this form to withdraw from your contract. No customer account is needed. After sending you receive a confirmation of receipt by email.
widerruf.name: Name
widerruf.items: Which items are you withdrawing from? (leave empty for the whole order)
widerruf.confirm_note: Confirming declares the withdrawal bindingly. Receipt is confirmed to you by email without delay.
widerruf.nojs: Without JavaScript, submit the form directly with the button below.
widerruf.success_text: We have received your withdrawal. A confirmation of receipt with date and time will reach you by email. Please send the goods back within 14 days.
widerruf.privacy_note: Your details are processed solely to handle the withdrawal (Art. 6(1)(b) and (c) GDPR) and are not used for advertising. Details and your rights: Privacy policy.
widerruf.alt_note: You can also declare the withdrawal informally by email or letter. The model withdrawal form is in the withdrawal policy.
widerruf.open_page: Open the withdrawal form on its own page
